_readme: Starting policies, all priors to be updated by NUMA's own data (strategy.py). Score units: a post's score is roughly ln(its metric / NUMA's rolling median for that post type), winsorised, so +0.15 is about 16% better than NUMA's median and 0 is the median. prior_means are cold-start tilts in those units; prior_strength is how many posts' worth of weight a research prior gets (measured 3, observed 2, opinion 1), so NUMA's own posts outweigh research after a handful. Judging windows: spec default (early read at 72 h, final at 7 d) until R6/R7 research is imported. Planning rules (shoot_card.py check, spec p.34) always override these numbers.

rules: At most one sales-focused post a week (spec p.34 rule 1).
Ask the DPT never sells (brand.json claims.rules education).
Experience first, offer in the last beat (opinion).
Never state a price whose brand.json status is needs_katie.
Nothing that invites people in on a closure day (spec p.34 rule 8).
Weeks without an offer carry the collab or Meet the Collective feature in the sales slot (default week).

Missing metrics drop out and the weights re-normalise; a conversion post with no conversion metrics is scored on reach.
